method: Internet Archive CDX (first capture of each month, consecutive identical digests dropped; the last 13 months plus the last capture before them), up to 5 distinct captures per page sampled evenly, main text extracted and diffed line by line; the live page compared with the newest capture. Pages that now return 404/410 or redirect to a homepage count as removed. Only substantive lines count (30+ characters and 5+ words), so menus, buttons and page titles are ignored; changes under 60 characters are ignored.
